features: 3 classically embroidered Mickey-face silhouettes, 3 solid colored cloths
Part of the Mickey Mouse bath collection
description: Celebrate you love for Mickey with these fun Disney Mickey Mouse Washcloths. They are an ideal gift for Disney fans of all ages. Each washcloth bundle includes six towels. The towels feature three famous Mickey Mouse images in vibrant and striking red, white and black. These bath washcloths are made from 100% cotton for a soft feel and durability. Each one measures 12" x 12". Collect more Disney characters from the Mickey Mouse bath collection and turn your home into a fun and colorful place that will delight guests as much as children.
